description: ARDecipher by databhor: a terminal-hacking puzzle. Find the password among the words within 5 tries: each wrong guess tells you how many letters were in the right place.

descriptions.en: ARDecipher by databhor: a terminal-hacking puzzle. Find the password among the words within 5 tries: each wrong guess tells you how many letters were in the right place.
descriptions.it: ARDecipher di databhor: un rompicapo in cui forzi un terminale. Trova la password tra le parole in 5 tentativi: ogni errore ti dice quante lettere erano al posto giusto.
